protocol.error: relative H1 against the manufactured solution
protocol.threshold_cost: First recorded initial, accepted, transfer, or final state with error <= threshold; line-search coefficient fits are included in its solve count.
protocol.threshold_scope: All starts and optimizer statuses are retained. Threshold attainment and successful optimizer termination are distinct. Medians exclude unreached starts and are labelled accordingly.
protocol.history_note: Training histories store H1 state norms, not target errors. Errors here are independently reevaluated; running minima are separate from returned-state errors.
protocol.conditioning_note: Recorded maximum condition number of the column-scaled quadratic coefficient matrix; this is neither the nonlinear coefficient Hessian nor the geometry Hessian.
